en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Abu Najran, raising it,
‘Heasws said: ‘On the Day of Judgement, three would be upon dunes of Musk – one of them a Muezzin reciting Azān in anticipation (of the Rewards of Allahazwj)’.
en.sarwar: 27. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Najran in a marfu‘ manner who has said the following: “
Three things on the Day of Judgment are on sands of musk. One of them is one who says Adhan just for the sake of Allah.”
